references.text: The priest shall examine the sore and declare the person unclean if it has spread – the same procedure described in verse 27.
The priest declares the person unclean when the rash has spread on the skin, an identical assessment criterion as in verse 27.
The same wording about the rash spreading on the skin and the priest's declaration of uncleanness and leprosy.
Parallel text concerning the priest's examination and declaration of leprosy (נֶגַע צָרַעַת) when the condition has spread.
Examination on the seventh day and assessment of whether the plague has spread, the same timeframe and procedure.
The priest comes and sees that the plague has spread, and declares it leprosy – the same diagnostic principle.
Reference to following the priests' guidance regarding leprosy, as described in Leviticus 13.
